landing.headline: Build high-quality exams in minutes
landing.sub: Upload your test banks, let AI extract and tag questions, then generate polished exams and answer keys — all in one place.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to build better exams
landing.featuresSub: From raw documents to polished exam papers — Examuna handles the heavy lifting.
landing.feature1Desc: Upload PDF, Word, or image files and let AI parse them into tagged, reusable exam questions with topics and difficulty levels.
landing.feature2Desc: Set your subject, difficulty, and marks. Review each question — keep, swap, edit, or remove — until your exam is perfect.
landing.feature3Desc: Download professional Word documents with clean formatting, student info fields, and a separate answer key.
landing.howSub: Three simple steps to your next exam.
landing.step1Desc: Drop your past papers, worksheets, or scanned documents into Examuna.
landing.step2Desc: AI extracts questions and you assemble the perfect exam with drag-and-drop.
landing.step3Desc: Download a formatted Word document ready for printing or sharing.
landing.benefit1Desc: Questions are tagged with IB bands, cognitive levels, and topics.
landing.benefit2Desc: What used to take hours of copy-pasting now takes minutes.
landing.benefit3Desc: All files are stored securely. Only you can access your question bank.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to build your next exam?
landing.ctaSub: Join teachers who are saving hours every week with AI-powered exam creation.
landing.footer: Examuna. Built for teachers, powered by AI.
